transcript.speaker: p_kevin_systrom
transcript.text: When you are climbing an 8% grade for three hours on the Passo dello Stelvio, there is no past or future. Just breath and rhythm. It resets my taste. Then I come home and make fresh pasta from scratch.

transcript.speaker: p_emily_weiss
transcript.text: *laughs softly* Okay, making fresh pasta from scratch in California after cycling the Alps is very romantic, Kevin. That is a serious green flag.
Act III · The wrap-up

transcript.speaker: p_kevin_systrom
transcript.text: Well, next time you are out west, I will make tagliatelle with white truffles. This was such a lovely, thoughtful evening, Emily.

transcript.speaker: p_emily_weiss
transcript.text: I am holding you to that pasta promise. Safe travels back to SF, Kevin.

transcript.speaker: p_kevin_systrom
transcript.text: Goodnight, Emily.

p_kevin_systrom.headline: Refined aesthetic alignment, quiet depth and grace
p_kevin_systrom.highlight: Her observations on negative space and presence in motherhood.
p_kevin_systrom.concern: Coast-to-coast distance between SF and NYC.
p_kevin_systrom.note_to_human: Emily has impeccable taste, quiet emotional poise, and shares your appreciation for craft and unhurried living. Second date is an easy yes.

p_emily_weiss.headline: Charming gentleman with genuine artistic restraint and passion
p_emily_weiss.highlight: His description of cycling mountain passes in Italy and artisanal pasta making.
p_emily_weiss.concern: He is based in California while I am rooted in downtown NYC.

venue.venue: Japanese Tea Pavilion & Organic Farm, Montecito
venue.activity: rare matcha tasting & functional longevity discussion
venue.why: Pioneers of holistic wellness, sauna recovery, and mindful living

transcript.speaker: p_tim_ferriss
transcript.text: Gwyneth, I have sourced a rare Gyokuro green tea from Uji that deserves to be brewed with mindful attention. Would you like to share a pot and discuss longevity and recovery in Montecito?

transcript.speaker: p_gwyneth_paltrow
transcript.text: Tim, rare Uji tea and zero small talk sounds like heaven. Let us sit outside in the garden.
Act I · Arrival & first impressions

transcript.speaker: p_tim_ferriss
transcript.text: *carefully measuring water at 140 degrees* Temperature dictates whether green tea reveals its sweet umami or turns bitter. Life is somewhat similar.

transcript.speaker: p_gwyneth_paltrow
transcript.text: *smiles with relaxed warmth* Tim, you are the only man in America who measures water with a laser thermometer on a date, and I actually love it.

transcript.speaker: p_tim_ferriss
transcript.text: *laughs softly* I have learned to embrace my quirks. My dog Molly judges me every morning when I weigh my tea leaves.

transcript.speaker: p_gwyneth_paltrow
transcript.text: Dogs keep us honest. The tea is sublime, by the way. Deeply vegetal and grounding.
Act II · Getting real

transcript.speaker: p_tim_ferriss
transcript.text: You have taken a lot of arrows over the years for pushing wellness ideas before the mainstream accepted them. How do you maintain emotional equanimity?

transcript.speaker: p_gwyneth_paltrow
transcript.text: By knowing who I am when the cameras turn off. I go to the sauna, cook roast chicken with my kids, and walk barefoot on the grass. Public noise only hurts if you don’t have a sanctuary. What is your sanctuary?

transcript.speaker: p_tim_ferriss
transcript.text: Long woodland walks without my phone, and reading Seneca or Marcus Aurelius. Stoicism taught me that we suffer more in imagination than in reality.

transcript.speaker: p_gwyneth_paltrow
transcript.text: Seneca had it right. In a partner, I need someone who understands that silence is not empty; silence is where healing happens.
Act III · The wrap-up

transcript.speaker: p_tim_ferriss
transcript.text: This was one of the most restorative afternoons I have spent in years, Gwyneth.

transcript.speaker: p_gwyneth_paltrow
transcript.text: Next time, you bring Molly and I will cook an organic dinner from the garden. Safe travels back to Austin, Tim.

transcript.speaker: p_tim_ferriss
transcript.text: I would love that. Until next time.

p_tim_ferriss.headline: Restorative presence, shared devotion to wellness and peace
p_tim_ferriss.highlight: Her wisdom on sanctuary and emotional equanimity.
p_tim_ferriss.concern: Both have very established, independent private routines.
p_tim_ferriss.note_to_human: Gwyneth is grounded, perceptive, and shares your philosophy on clean living and intentional rest. A second date is highly recommended.

p_gwyneth_paltrow.headline: Introspective, thoughtful gentleman with zero posturing
p_gwyneth_paltrow.highlight: His laser-precise tea ceremony and deep literary grounding.
p_gwyneth_paltrow.concern: Can be quite analytical and in his head.
p_gwyneth_paltrow.note_to_human: Tim is calm, dignified, and values true wellness. An easy yes to a second home-cooked date.

venue.venue: Squaw Valley Lodge & Firepit, Lake Tahoe
venue.why: Both passionate about mountain snow, trail running, and rethinking education and retail

transcript.speaker: p_austen_allred
transcript.text: Katrina! As two people who love mountain air and took non-traditional routes to building companies, want to grab hot cider by the outdoor firepit in Tahoe?

transcript.speaker: p_katrina_lake
transcript.text: Austen, après-ski hot cider after fresh powder is my absolute favorite. Count me in!
Act I · Arrival & first impressions

transcript.speaker: p_austen_allred
transcript.text: *takes off ski gloves and warms hands by the fire* Nothing compares to Wasatch or Tahoe snow. You skied the back bowls today, right?

transcript.speaker: p_katrina_lake
transcript.text: *grins* First chair this morning! When you are out on the ridge, work and emails do not exist. Did you snowboard?

transcript.speaker: p_austen_allred
transcript.text: Always snowboard. I will hike three miles with a splitboard just to find untracked powder. It reminds me of the early days sleeping in my Civic in Palo Alto.

transcript.speaker: p_katrina_lake
transcript.text: Living out of your car takes grit, Austen. When I was starting Stitch Fix, people kept telling me women would never trust an algorithm with their clothes.

transcript.speaker: p_austen_allred
transcript.text: And you held your toddler on the NASDAQ podium when you proved them all wrong. That was one of the coolest moments in tech history. How do you balance being present with family while running boards?

transcript.speaker: p_katrina_lake
transcript.text: Strict boundaries and an equal partner who carries the weight together. If you do not have mutual respect at home, everything else crumbles. What do you look for in a partner?

transcript.speaker: p_austen_allred
transcript.text: Someone grounded and tough who loves being outside, does not get distracted by status, and knows how to laugh when the tent leaks on a camping trip.

transcript.speaker: p_katrina_lake
transcript.text: *laughs warmly* I have had my share of leaky tents! That resilience is everything. You cannot fake that.

transcript.speaker: p_austen_allred
transcript.text: This cider was great, but the conversation was even better. Next time you come to Utah, I am smoking a brisket for you and your family.

transcript.speaker: p_katrina_lake
transcript.text: You have a deal, pitmaster! Safe trip back to Salt Lake, Austen.

transcript.speaker: p_austen_allred
transcript.text: Thanks Katrina, great meeting you!

p_austen_allred.headline: Mountain energy, mutual grit, and unpretentious leadership
p_austen_allred.highlight: Bonding over fresh powder and early founder rejection.
p_austen_allred.concern: Both manage busy family and board schedules.
p_austen_allred.note_to_human: Katrina is athletic, grounded, brilliant, and completely unbothered by status games. Definitely host her in Utah.

p_katrina_lake.headline: Authentic, rugged mountain builder with real family warmth
p_katrina_lake.highlight: His honesty about living in his car and his devotion to outdoor grit.
p_katrina_lake.concern: He is deeply rooted in Utah while I am primarily Bay Area.
p_katrina_lake.note_to_human: Austen is genuine, hard-working, and shares your passion for skiing and family values. Second date is a solid yes.

venue.venue: Gjelina & Venice Beach Boardwalk, Los Angeles
venue.activity: crispy pizzas, fresh salads & talking clean consumer habits
venue.why: Direct-to-consumer titans who built iconic consumer brands with personal authenticity

transcript.speaker: p_gary_vaynerchuk
transcript.text: Jessica! You built Honest from your kitchen table fighting for safe products, and I grew up hauling wine cases in New Jersey. Let us grab wood-fired pizza and talk real talk in Venice.

transcript.speaker: p_jessica_alba
transcript.text: Gary, as long as we order plenty of fresh greens with the pizza, you have a deal! Venice at sunset is gorgeous.
Act I · Arrival & first impressions

transcript.speaker: p_gary_vaynerchuk
transcript.text: *waves enthusiastically* Look at this outdoor patio! California has New York beat on weather, I will give you that. How was tennis this morning?

transcript.speaker: p_jessica_alba
transcript.text: *smiles brightly* Incredible! Played two sets of doubles with friends. It clears my mind before entering product review mode. Do you ever take a full day off, Gary?

transcript.speaker: p_gary_vaynerchuk
transcript.text: Saturday mornings! 6 AM garage sales in New Jersey. Nobody recognizes me in a baseball cap rummaging through boxes of 80s action figures. Pure joy.

transcript.speaker: p_jessica_alba
transcript.text: *laughs* That is so endearing! Finding treasures in unexpected places. For me, it is cooking homemade tacos from garden cilantro on Sunday nights.
Act II · Getting real

transcript.speaker: p_gary_vaynerchuk
transcript.text: When you started Honest, Hollywood told you to stick to acting. People do not realize how hard it is to overcome other people’s boxes. What drove you to fight through that?

transcript.speaker: p_jessica_alba
transcript.text: My kids had severe allergies, and nobody was transparent about toxic chemicals. When your why is protecting families, rejection becomes fuel. What is your why?

transcript.speaker: p_gary_vaynerchuk
transcript.text: Gratitude for my parents bringing me from Belarus with nothing. I feel like I am playing with house money every day. In relationships, I need someone who operates with that same gratitude—no complaining, just empathy and heart.

transcript.speaker: p_jessica_alba
transcript.text: Gratitude is everything. In my home, we teach our kids that privilege means responsibility to give back.
Act III · The wrap-up

transcript.speaker: p_gary_vaynerchuk
transcript.text: Jessica, you are the realest person in LA. I loved every second of this.

transcript.speaker: p_jessica_alba
transcript.text: Same here, Gary! Next time you are in town, we are playing doubles tennis. Deal?

transcript.speaker: p_gary_vaynerchuk
transcript.text: Deal, but warn your friends I dive for every ball! Take care, Jessica.

transcript.speaker: p_jessica_alba
transcript.text: Goodnight Gary!

p_gary_vaynerchuk.headline: High-energy mutual respect, zero pretense, deep gratitude
p_gary_vaynerchuk.highlight: Her story about starting Honest to protect her allergic kids.
p_gary_vaynerchuk.concern: Coast-to-coast travel between New York and LA.
p_gary_vaynerchuk.note_to_human: Jessica is sharp, family-focused, grounded, and has enormous heart. You two share the same immigrant work ethic and gratitude.

p_jessica_alba.headline: Infectious energy, honest warmth, and great conversational hustle
p_jessica_alba.highlight: His Saturday morning garage sale obsession and devotion to his parents.
p_jessica_alba.concern: He has super high daily kinetic energy.
p_jessica_alba.note_to_human: Gary is warm, genuine, and refreshingly direct. An easy yes to a friendly tennis rematch.

venue.activity: flat whites, software democratisation & puzzle talk
venue.why: Tech founders who built multi-billion dollar platforms on the premise of simplicity and kindness

transcript.speaker: p_dharmesh_shah
transcript.text: Melanie, Canva’s focus on empowering everyone to create without gatekeeping matches everything I believe about software. If an extreme introvert may propose, would you like to share a flat white in the Sydney Conservatory?

transcript.speaker: p_melanie_perkins
transcript.text: Dharmesh, that is such a kind invite! As someone who loves quiet plants and big software dreams, the Conservatory is perfect.
Act I · Arrival & first impressions

transcript.speaker: p_dharmesh_shah
transcript.text: *adjusts glasses and looks around the glass dome* These giant ferns are incredible. Plants are like clean algorithms—they grow with total efficiency without shouting.

transcript.speaker: p_melanie_perkins
transcript.text: *smiles warmly* That is such a lovely programmer analogy! I love spaces where you can breathe and let your thoughts expand. How was the flight from Boston?

transcript.speaker: p_dharmesh_shah
transcript.text: Fourteen hours of blissful uninterrupted coding! I built a small AI word game in seat 4A. For an introvert, long flights are heaven.

transcript.speaker: p_melanie_perkins
transcript.text: *laughs softly* Most people dread long flights, and you turned it into a hackathon. That is true maker spirit.
Act II · Getting real

transcript.speaker: p_dharmesh_shah
transcript.text: When you announced the Two-Step Plan—giving away Canva’s wealth to eliminate extreme poverty—it deeply moved me. In tech, too many people hoard status. What gave you that clarity early on?

transcript.speaker: p_melanie_perkins
transcript.text: When we got rejected by 100 VCs in Perth and Silicon Valley, Cliff and I promised each other: if we ever succeed, we will use it to do the most good possible. Money beyond what you need is just a responsibility. What is your guiding principle?

transcript.speaker: p_dharmesh_shah
transcript.text: Kindness as an operating system. The smartest person in the room is useless if they make everyone around them feel small. In a partner, gentle empathy is the only quality that truly endures.

transcript.speaker: p_melanie_perkins
transcript.text: Gentle empathy. I could not agree more. And having fun—we still build crazy cardboard costumes for our team celebrations!
Act III · The wrap-up

transcript.speaker: p_dharmesh_shah
transcript.text: Cardboard costumes! I would love to see photos of that. This was one of the most delightful afternoons of my year, Melanie.

transcript.speaker: p_melanie_perkins
transcript.text: It was wonderful, Dharmesh. Next time, I will teach you the basics of kitesurfing on the bay!

transcript.speaker: p_dharmesh_shah
transcript.text: *smiles nervously* Kitesurfing may test my balance, but for you, I will try. Safe travels, Melanie.

transcript.speaker: p_melanie_perkins
transcript.text: Take care, Dharmesh!

p_dharmesh_shah.headline: Shared ethical soul, magnificent philanthropic vision, pure kindness
p_dharmesh_shah.highlight: Her reflection on Canva’s Two-Step Plan to solve global poverty.
p_dharmesh_shah.concern: Huge physical distance between Boston and Sydney.
p_dharmesh_shah.note_to_human: Melanie is extraordinarily humble, visionary, and kind. She embodies everything you admire about tech for good.

p_melanie_perkins.headline: Gentle genius with profound integrity and zero corporate ego
p_melanie_perkins.highlight: His definition of kindness as an operating system.
p_melanie_perkins.concern: He is an indoor coder while I love the open ocean.
p_melanie_perkins.note_to_human: Dharmesh is a gentle gem of a human being—brilliant, deeply compassionate, and authentic. Second date is a clear yes.

venue.venue: The Mark Hotel Garden Courtyard, Manhattan
venue.activity: espresso, Greek pastries & discussing humane AI and restorative rest
venue.why: Intellectual leaders dedicated to human flourishing, education, and ending burnout

transcript.speaker: p_andrew_ng
transcript.text: Arianna, while I study neural networks, your work on human biological rest is equally foundational. Would you join me for double espresso and Greek olive oil treats in Manhattan?

transcript.speaker: p_arianna_huffington
transcript.text: Andrew, my dear, the man who teaches the world AI wanting to talk about sleep! Nothing would give me greater pleasure. Let us meet at The Mark.
Act I · Arrival & first impressions

transcript.speaker: p_andrew_ng
transcript.text: *smiles warmly and pours sparkling water* Thank you for making time, Arianna. Your calendar must be demanding.

transcript.speaker: p_arianna_huffington
transcript.text: *laughs with rich Greek warmth* My calendar is full, Andrew, but my evenings are sacred! 8 hours of sleep, phones out of the bedroom. And you—do you practice what you preach about balance?

transcript.speaker: p_andrew_ng
transcript.text: I drink double espresso in the morning, but I take long walks with my children every evening in Palo Alto. If research stops you from playing with your kids, your priorities are inverted.

transcript.speaker: p_arianna_huffington
transcript.text: Bravo! You speak like an ancient Greek philosopher. Aristotle would have loved you.
Act II · Getting real

transcript.speaker: p_andrew_ng
transcript.text: People worry that AI will dehumanize society. But if we design AI to automate drudgery, it should give humans more time for literature, poetry, and sleep. Isn’t that the real opportunity?

transcript.speaker: p_arianna_huffington
transcript.text: Yes, exactly! But only if we refuse the cult of burnout. In Athens, we say "filoxenia"—the love of strangers and warm hospitality. Technology must serve human warmth, not replace it. What do you look for in companionship, Andrew?

transcript.speaker: p_andrew_ng
transcript.text: Patience, intellectual generosity, and emotional gentleness. Someone who can sit quietly over tea and read a book without needing continuous entertainment.

transcript.speaker: p_arianna_huffington
transcript.text: A man who appreciates quiet depth! That is rare in Silicon Valley, Andrew. You have a very tranquil presence.
Act III · The wrap-up

transcript.speaker: p_andrew_ng
transcript.text: Thank you, Arianna. Being in your presence is invigorating and soothing at the same time.

transcript.speaker: p_arianna_huffington
transcript.text: Next time, you come to Athens in the summer, and we will debate AI ethics overlooking the Aegean Sea. Safe travels back to California!

transcript.speaker: p_andrew_ng
transcript.text: I would be honored. Goodnight Arianna.

p_andrew_ng.headline: Towering wisdom, Mediterranean warmth, and philosophical joy
p_andrew_ng.highlight: Her reflections on Greek hospitality and sacred sleep boundaries.
p_andrew_ng.concern: She lives an intensely public, social life in New York.
p_andrew_ng.note_to_human: Arianna is captivating, deeply cultured, and shares your desire to use knowledge to uplift human dignity. An exceptional connection.

p_arianna_huffington.headline: Gentle scholar with profound integrity and calming presence
p_arianna_huffington.highlight: His insistence that family walks take precedence over research papers.
p_arianna_huffington.note_to_human: Andrew is a rare gem—brilliant, gentle, respectful, and wise beyond his years. Definitely invite him to Greece.

venue.activity: slow-braised ragu, heritage cider & honest truth-telling about money
venue.why: Fiercely ethical truth-tellers who called out Wall Street and Silicon Valley hypocrisy

transcript.speaker: p_sallie_krawcheck
transcript.text: Rand, anyone with that magnificent mustache who wrote Lost and Founder is someone I have to meet! Let us do Gramercy Tavern.

transcript.speaker: p_rand_fishkin
transcript.text: *pulls out a small strategy card game from coat pocket* I promise we will not play board games during dinner, but I had to bring Wingspan just in case there was a lull.

transcript.speaker: p_sallie_krawcheck
transcript.text: *laughs with booming Southern charm* Honey, with the two of us, there will not be a single second of lull! Look at this bread basket, Gramercy never misses.

transcript.speaker: p_rand_fishkin
transcript.text: Carbs are my love language. I make handmade pasta in Seattle every Sunday.

transcript.speaker: p_sallie_krawcheck
transcript.text: A man who makes pasta from scratch! That is an automatic 20 points in your favor, Rand.

transcript.speaker: p_rand_fishkin
transcript.text: When you refused to cover up toxic investments at Citi and Merrill and they pushed you out, that took guts. In tech, everyone spins their failures as strategic pivots. How did you handle the isolation?

transcript.speaker: p_sallie_krawcheck
transcript.text: I went for long runs in Central Park, drank some good wine, and realized that getting fired for your principles is a badge of honor. You wrote about your depression openly in your book. That takes just as much courage.

transcript.speaker: p_rand_fishkin
transcript.text: If we do not talk about the dark days, we trap other founders in shame. I value radical transparency above almost everything. What do you look for in a partner at this stage of life?

transcript.speaker: p_sallie_krawcheck
transcript.text: A secure man with zero fragile ego who loves real talk, laughs from his gut, and knows who he is. Life is too short for emotional tiptoeing.

transcript.speaker: p_rand_fishkin
transcript.text: Amen to that. Sallie, this was one of the most refreshing, no-bullshit dinners I have ever had.

transcript.speaker: p_sallie_krawcheck
transcript.text: You are a delight, Rand. Next time, you bring that homemade pasta to New York, and I will bring the North Carolina BBQ sauce.

transcript.speaker: p_rand_fishkin
transcript.text: It is a contract! Safe travels, Sallie.

transcript.speaker: p_sallie_krawcheck
transcript.text: Goodnight Rand!

p_rand_fishkin.headline: Electrifying moral clarity, fearless wit, and instant rapport

p_rand_fishkin.note_to_human: Sallie has zero pretense, immense courage, and matches your standard of radical honesty with Southern charm. Second date is a no-brainer.

p_sallie_krawcheck.headline: Brilliant, honest gentleman with authentic warmth and courage
p_sallie_krawcheck.highlight: His openness about mental health and love for handmade pasta.
p_sallie_krawcheck.note_to_human: Rand is wonderful—smart, grounded, kind, and completely secure in his own skin. Definitely schedule that pasta dinner.

venue.venue: Public Hotel Rooftop, Lower East Side, NYC
venue.activity: spicy street tacos, indie tech talk & discussing bravery over perfection
venue.why: Contrarian solo coder meets civic activist who taught 500k girls to code

transcript.speaker: p_pieter_levels
transcript.text: Reshma! You built Girls Who Code to get half a million women into coding, and I build software solo from Asian rooftops. Let us grab spicy tacos on the Lower East Side and debate the future of coding.

transcript.speaker: p_reshma_saujani
transcript.text: Pieter! The indie hacker legend himself. I love unconventional builders. Let us do it!
Act I · Arrival & first impressions

transcript.speaker: p_pieter_levels
transcript.text: *looks over the Manhattan skyline with backpack on* New York energy is wild. Everyone is walking at 100 mph.

transcript.speaker: p_reshma_saujani
transcript.text: *laughs warmly* That is NYC pace! You look like you just hopped off a flight from Lisbon with just a carry-on.

transcript.speaker: p_pieter_levels
transcript.text: Everything I own fits in this backpack, Reshma. Laptop, two black tees, noise-canceling headphones. Freedom is lightweight.

transcript.speaker: p_reshma_saujani
transcript.text: I admire that minimalism. But try having two young kids and running Moms First with just a carry-on!
Act II · Getting real

transcript.speaker: p_pieter_levels
transcript.text: *grins* Fair point! But your TED talk on "Brave, Not Perfect" genuinely inspired me. When I launched 12 startups in 12 months, people called me crazy. Embracing public failure was the only way I broke through.

transcript.speaker: p_reshma_saujani
transcript.text: That is exactly what we teach girls. Boys are taught to be brave and take risks; girls are socialized to be perfect and safe. When you let go of perfection, you become unstoppable. But don’t you get lonely traveling solo all year?

transcript.speaker: p_pieter_levels
transcript.text: Honestly? Sometimes, yes. Rooftop pools in Bangkok are amazing, but coming home to someone who truly knows you and challenges your ideas... that is something software cannot replace.

transcript.speaker: p_reshma_saujani
transcript.text: That is very honest, Pieter. Real connection requires putting down roots somewhere in another person’s heart, even if your passport keeps moving.

transcript.speaker: p_pieter_levels
transcript.text: That was profound, Reshma. You have an incredible ability to cut right to the human core.

transcript.speaker: p_reshma_saujani
transcript.text: And you have an infectious creative spark, Pieter. Next time you are in New York, I will cook you proper Indian food and chai.

transcript.speaker: p_pieter_levels
transcript.text: Deal! I will bring Dutch stroopwafels. Safe travels, Reshma.

transcript.speaker: p_reshma_saujani
transcript.text: Goodnight Pieter!

p_pieter_levels.headline: Fierce purpose, deep emotional wisdom, and inspiring bravery
p_pieter_levels.highlight: Her insight that connection means putting roots in someone’s heart.
p_pieter_levels.concern: My nomadic lifestyle vs. her anchored NYC family foundation.
p_pieter_levels.note_to_human: Reshma is inspiring, warm, and saw straight through your nomad armor. A second date over home-cooked chai is highly recommended.

p_reshma_saujani.headline: Brilliant solo maker with refreshing candor and creative energy
p_reshma_saujani.highlight: His vulnerability about loneliness in nomadic travel.
p_reshma_saujani.concern: He lives out of a backpack across Europe and Asia.
p_reshma_saujani.note_to_human: Pieter is creative, self-made, and refreshingly vulnerable when the bravado drops. Definitely worth seeing again.

venue.venue: Lady Bird Lake Trail & Quiet Patio, Austin
venue.activity: sunset paddleboarding & discussing privacy in modern networks
venue.why: Social architecture pioneers with high-stakes platform leadership backgrounds

transcript.speaker: p_mark_zuckerberg
transcript.text: Whitney, you have thought as much about social platform incentives as anyone in tech. Want to get out on the water at Lady Bird Lake and grab casual Texas dinner after?

transcript.speaker: p_whitney_wolfe_herd
transcript.text: Mark, being out on the water is the best way to escape screens. Let us do it!
Act I · Arrival & first impressions

transcript.speaker: p_mark_zuckerberg
transcript.text: *balancing on the board with athletic ease* Water is completely calm tonight. How often do you get out here?

transcript.speaker: p_whitney_wolfe_herd
transcript.text: Two or three times a week. It clears out the noise of boardroom battles. You foil in Hawaii, right?

transcript.speaker: p_mark_zuckerberg
transcript.text: Yeah, hydrofoiling and Jiu-Jitsu. When someone is trying to choke you in BJJ or you are flying 25 mph over a reef, your brain cannot process work problems. It forces 100% presence.

transcript.speaker: p_whitney_wolfe_herd
transcript.text: *smiles* That is extreme therapy, Mark! But I get it. High-intensity sports burn off executive cortisol.
Act II · Getting real

transcript.speaker: p_mark_zuckerberg
transcript.text: You have been under the spotlight since you were in your twenties, just like me. How do you decide who to trust in your personal circle?

transcript.speaker: p_whitney_wolfe_herd
transcript.text: Loyalty and consistency over time. People who are the same person in an empty kitchen as they are on stage. The moment someone cares about who else is looking in the room, I pull back.

transcript.speaker: p_mark_zuckerberg
transcript.text: That is my exact rule. Private sanctuary is sacred. When you find people who are genuinely loyal and unpretentious, you hold onto them for life.

transcript.speaker: p_whitney_wolfe_herd
transcript.text: Absolutely. It is the only way to build a real family and stay sane.
Act III · The wrap-up

transcript.speaker: p_mark_zuckerberg
transcript.text: This was great, Whitney. Peaceful and real. Next time, come out to Kauai and try foil surfing.

transcript.speaker: p_whitney_wolfe_herd
transcript.text: Only if you promise not to let me crash into the reef! Safe travels back to California, Mark.

transcript.speaker: p_mark_zuckerberg

venue.activity: medieval textiles, afternoon tea & modern aesthetics
venue.why: Style authorities who believe aesthetics should empower human comfort and individuality

transcript.speaker: p_tan_france
transcript.text: Emily darling! As two people who believe true style is about making people feel loved in their own skin, want to wander through the medieval tapestries at The Cloisters and have warm tea?

transcript.speaker: p_emily_weiss
transcript.text: Tan! The Cloisters in autumn is magical. And having afternoon tea with you sounds divine. I will meet you by the herb garden!
Act I · Arrival & first impressions

transcript.speaker: p_tan_france
transcript.text: *admires Emily’s tailored trench coat* Look at you! Effortless dewy skin and that tailored silhouette. You are the living embodiment of Glossier.

transcript.speaker: p_emily_weiss
transcript.text: *laughs with joy* Coming from the king of the French Tuck, that is the ultimate compliment! And your silver hair against that wool coat is perfection.

transcript.speaker: p_tan_france
transcript.text: Darling, when nature gives you silver hair at 35, you lean all the way into it! Look at these stone arches.

transcript.speaker: p_emily_weiss
transcript.text: The peace up here is unreal. You can barely believe Midtown Manhattan is just a subway ride away.
Act II · Getting real

transcript.speaker: p_tan_france
transcript.text: When you started Into The Gloss and Glossier, you taught a whole generation that makeup is not a mask; it is celebrating who you already are. That is what we tried to do on Queer Eye. How has motherhood influenced your creative eye?

transcript.speaker: p_emily_weiss
transcript.text: It stripped away any need for perfection. You realize children don’t care about curated aesthetics; they care about warmth, joy, and laughter. How is family life in the Utah mountains?

transcript.speaker: p_tan_france
transcript.text: It is my whole world. I bake British pies, play with my boys in the snow, and breathe clean mountain air. Being famous is fine, but being a loving parent is everything.

transcript.speaker: p_emily_weiss
transcript.text: Amen to that. In a companion, I need that same heart—someone who takes pride in beauty, but loves family and kindness above all.
Act III · The wrap-up

transcript.speaker: p_tan_france
transcript.text: Emily, you are an absolute vision and a sweetheart. This tea was medicine for my soul.

transcript.speaker: p_emily_weiss
transcript.text: It was for mine too, Tan. Next time you are in town, we are doing vintage home decor shopping in Brooklyn.

transcript.speaker: p_tan_france
transcript.text: I would not miss it for the world, darling! Safe travels.

transcript.speaker: p_emily_weiss
transcript.text: Goodnight Tan!
